headline_result: Restricted summaries incurred 0.075 regret, but matched direct and posterior coordinates were equal; no restoration-specific advantage was isolated.

result_records.summary: Calibrated binary mean equals posterior decision control; noisy-label finite-sample gain is known-noise denoising.
limitations: Controlled synthetic experiment only, no market/novelty claim.
Binary population controls are algebraic identities, not independently learned methods.
Finite self-distillation vector is copied, not learned; matched-supervision direct learner is next.
Decision intervals at n120 and n480 include zero; preserve finite-sample uncertainty.

result_records.summary: Author reports matched direct/posterior coordinate equality; restricted-summary regret.075 and correct-symmetry sample-efficiency gains; no restoration-specific benefit.
limitations: Synthetic known-law experiment; coordinate identity and prior-based variance reduction do not establish reconstruction novelty.
